# Introduciion #

## Read data ##

```{r}
# filenames
datapath <- "e:/Projects/GPWG/work/feedback/data/"
char_file <- paste(datapath, "GCDv3i/", "v3i_nsa_globe_binboot_zt2kb_pbw10_bw50_200.csv", sep="")
char_label <- "Z-Scores (50-yr bins)"
d13C_file <- paste(datapath, "d13C/", "NS_dc13_adjust_lwrboot_span_0.1_200.csv", sep="")
d13C_label <- "d13C (lwr, span=0.1)"
CH4_file <- paste(datapath, "CH4/", "law2006_CH4_lwrboot_span_0.1_200.csv", sep="")
CH4_label <- "CH4 (lwr, span-0.1)"
```

```{r, results="hide"}
# read data
char_data <- read.csv(char_file); names(char_data)
d13C_data <- read.csv(d13C_file); names(d13C_data)
CH4_data <- read.csv(CH4_file); names(CH4_data)
```

```{r}
# merge data
data_all <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow=46, ncol=5))
names(data_all) <- c("age", "YearCE", "char", "d13C", "CH4")
data_all[1:3] <- char_data[1:3]
data_all$d13C[1:dim(d13C_data)[1]] <- d13C_data[1:dim(d13C_data)[1], 3]
data_all$CH4[1:dim(CH4_data)[1]] <- CH4_data[1:dim(CH4_data)[1], 3]
data_all <- data_all[1:41, ]
#print(data_all)
```

```{r}
# remove observations with missing temperature data
data_all <- na.exclude(data_all)
```


## Pre-industrial era data ##

```{r}
preind <- data_all[data_all$YearCE < 1750, ]
print(preind)
```

## Scatter plots ##

```{r}
# function for plotting two series at a time
plotseries <- function(title, dataset, xvarin, yvar1in, yvar2in) {
  xvar <- dataset[,xvarin]
  yvar1 <- dataset[,yvar1in]; yvar2 <- dataset[,yvar2in]
  opar <- par(mar=c(5,4,4,5)+0.1) # space for second axis
  plot(yvar1 ~ xvar, pch=16, xlab=xvarin, ylab=yvar1in, col="red", data=dataset,
    main=title)
  par(new=T)          # second plot is going to get added to first
  plot(yvar2 ~ xvar, xlab="", pch=16, axes=F, ylab="", col="blue", data=dataset)
  axis(side=4); mtext(side=4,line=3.8,yvar2in)
  legend("bottomleft", c(yvar1in,yvar2in), pch=16, col=c("red","blue"))
  par(opar)  # restore plot parameters
}
```

```{r}
plotseries("global charcoal and (adjusted) northern & southern d13C", preind, 
    "YearCE", "char", "d13C")
```



```{r, fig.asp=1.0, fig.width=5}
plot(preind$d13C, preind$char, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=c(-49, -47), ylim=c(-.2,.1), xlab=d13C_label, ylab=char_label)
text(preind$d13C, preind$char, lab=preind$YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
```

```{r}
plotseries("global charcoal and CH4", preind, "YearCE", "char", "CH4")
```


```{r, fig.asp=1.0, fig.width=5}
plot(preind$CH4, preind$char, pch=16, cex=0.5, xlim=c(625, 700), ylim=c(-0.2, 0.1), xlab=CH4_label, ylab=char_label)
text(preind$CH4, preind$char, lab=preind$YearCE, cex=0.7, pos=1)
```


# Regression #

```{r}
check_lm01 <- lm(char ~ I(d13C * CH4) + CH4, data=preind)
summary(check_lm01)
```

```{r}
check_lm01$coefficients
ratio <- check_lm01$coefficients[3]/check_lm01$coefficients[2]; names(ratio) <- "ratio"
print(ratio)
```

```{r, fig.asp=1.0, fig.width=6}
oldpar <- par(mfcol=c(2,2))
plot(check_lm01, which=c(1,2,4))
acf(check_lm01$residuals, main="ACF of residuals", font.main=1)
par <- oldpar
```

```{r}
fitted <- data.frame(cbind(preind, check_lm01$residuals, check_lm01$fitted.values))
plotseries("global charcoal and CH4", fitted, "YearCE", "char", "check_lm01.fitted.values")
```
```{r}
library(visreg)
```

More diagnostic analysis.

```{r}
oldpar <- par(mfcol=c(1,2))
visreg(check_lm01, points=list(pch=16, cex=1))
par <- oldpar
```

```{r, fig.asp=0.75, fig.width=5}
visreg2d(check_lm01, xvar="d13C", yvar= "CH4")
```
